evidence.title: Do Not Copy/Paste: Soft Barriers for Copying in AI-Assisted Programming

summary: A new study introduces the concept of soft barriers to discourage developers from blindly copying and pasting AI-generated code. The intervention aims to foster active code comprehension and reduce programming errors by adding intentional friction during AI-assisted development.
title: Research Explores 'Soft Barriers' to Reduce Copy-Pasting in AI-Assisted Programming
